title: Fancy Yellow Three-Stone
subtitle: A Fancy Yellow oval between two pears, all drawn from the same warmth.

stone.origin: Lab-grown. Centre: 6.06 ct oval. Sides: 0.85 + 0.89 ct pear. Matched saturation.

description: A Fancy Yellow oval at the centre, flanked by two Fancy Intense Yellow pears whose slightly deeper saturation frames the centre in the same family of colour. The three stones were matched so the eye reads one continuous warmth across the finger rather than three separate yellows — the pears leaning a shade richer, drawing the centre forward. The pears' points turn outward along the hand, extending the line. Set in eighteen-karat yellow gold or platinum, it is warmth composed in three parts.
